25 September, 2024 
Author: Vibhu Bakhru 
Bench: Vibhu Bakhru, Swarana Kanta Sharma
 $~59
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
 + W.P.(C) 7728/2024
 S N Consultant
 
 Through: Mr Aditya Kumar, Mr T
 Ms Priyanka Chawla an
 Banubuna, Advocates.
 ve
 Deputy Commissioner Of Customs & Anr.
 
 Through: Mr Aditya Singla, S
 Saha, Ms Sakshi Gar
 Bakshi, Ms Umang Mi
 for Cbic. 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vibhu Bakhru
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Order 
% 25.09.2024 CM APPL. 56537/2024 (direction) 
1. This application is filed by the petitioner, inter alia, praying that directions be issued for release of the goods (areca nuts) imported by the petitioner. The said goods have been detained by the Commissioner of Customs Preventive, New Delhi on the ground that the same were unfit for human consumption. 
2. The petitioner claims that the goods have since been examined by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).
3. In view of the above, we consider it apposite to direct the respondents to examine the report and pass an appropriate order. In the event the This is a digitally signed order. 
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
